subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public `skills.load` opt-out for built-in skill sources, and should that API be a closed source-id list or a narrower personal-source toggle?
rationale: The fix adds public config surface and changes built-in skill-source behavior, which AGENTS.md and VISION.md treat as compatibility-sensitive product/API direction rather than a routine bug patch.

options.title: Add closed source-id opt-out
options.body: Expose a default-empty `skills.load.disabledSources` style setting over known source ids and apply it before loader, watcher, status, docs, and tests.

options.title: Document existing filters only
options.body: Keep the current always-on sources and point users to agent allowlists, per-skill disables, and prompt limits, accepting that the personal tree is still scanned and watched.

options.title: Defer to on-demand skills design
options.body: Leave the source-toggle request open or close it only if maintainers choose a broader native on-demand skill-selection project instead.

recommendation.title: Add closed source-id opt-out
recommendation.body: Expose a default-empty `skills.load.disabledSources` style setting over known source ids and apply it before loader, watcher, status, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Current skills-loading, watcher, docs, and config-surface history points to this person as the best available owner for the config/API choice.
